## Features
- Set of 20 soft multi colour stake lights
- 6h on 18h off timer
- Battery operated (3 x AA Not included)
- Indoor or outdoor
- 8 functions

## Information
Lumineo set of 20 mini coloured LED mushroom stake lights. Create a warm and welcoming festive atmosphere to your indoor or outdoor space with these mini battery powered mushroom style stake lights. The soft multi coloured light makes ideal lighting for a pathway, in and around plant pots or simply a festive decoration around the home. The lights are battery powered and require 3 x AA batteries which are not included. The handy timer function allows 6 hours on and 18 hours off, automatically turning on and off at the same time each day. The lights feature an 8 function twinkle effect creating an extra magical touch to your festive decorations. Each mushroom light stands at approximately 20cm tall including the ground spike, and the mushroom head measures approximately 4cm in diameter. Ideal for pushing into a plant pot, gravel or garden edge to enhance your Christmas lighting display. In total, the lit length is 3.8m with a spacing of 20cm between each light and a 30cm lead cable from battery box to first light.
